model.name: FeatureManager.grantFeature impl
model.description: BUILT (R31.8 slice-b): FeatureManager.grantFeature(featureUuid, token, profiles, saveProfiles) — idempotently adds token→Feature.allowedUsers[] (scenario unit on disk, written fresh so featureAllowedUsers sees it at once) AND featureUuid→profile.features[], mirror BOTH sides atomically. Owner-gated at the caller: POST /api/feature-manager (requireOwnerHttp→assertOwner, HARDCODED owner root-of-trust INV-F4, distinct path from the data-driven /api/server-manager/* choke-point so a member cannot self-grant). Marker [impl:uuid:5e2f6781-...] on the grantFeature decl. No OWNER_TOKEN literal (INV-G2==1). Live effect: grant flips a live non-owner ServerManager 403→200 by membership (INV-F6).
